name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms
attribution: Romance of the Three Kingdoms (14th c.). Warlord borders drawn from commandery seats, approximate.
note: Years are real years. Each event is marked as recorded history, a real event embellished by the novel, or the novel's invention. Warlord borders are drawn from commandery seats and are approximate. Terrain and coastlines are modern.
note_zh: 年份为真实公元纪年。每个事件都标明是正史所载、史有其事而演义加工，还是小说虚构。群雄疆域按郡治推出，只是近似示意。地形、海岸线和河流均为现代地理。
